verdict.rationale: Event-driven automation is a fair axis for a community/chat platform, but the evidence shows only developer building blocks. The Gateway API and HTTP event notifications let developers write their own apps that react to events. Nothing documents a first-party way for users to define rules that trigger actions automatically. Missing for 10: a documented user-configurable rule/trigger system, event-to-action automation without custom bot code, and any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: The Gateway API lets apps open secure WebSocket connections with Discord to receive events about actions that take place in a server/guild
Send messages into Discord channels or receive event notifications from Discord delivered to your app over HTTP.
